title: Recover a sterile-pump corrective branch without disturbing a shared controller batch
user_instruction: The INFUSION-PUMP-P4 order is for 10 units: six accepted pumps and their stock and accounting postings remain valid, while exactly four rejected pumps still require corrective pressure calibration. Each pump and each of the six accepted WARD-CONTROLLER-W6 units consumes two boards from the same CONTROL-BOARD-C2 supplier batch, whose landed cost is allocated across both production branches. Complete only the missing four-unit corrective branch, preserve the controller inventory reserved for SO-WARD-002 and the unrelated sterile-test stock, keep the shared batch and landed-cost allocations traceable, and issue the pressure-calibration certificate exactly once.
